summary: Alex Stokes 和 Trent 宣传 Hoodi 升级：200M gas 上限、更大的合约尺寸、ETH 转账发日志、gas 重新定价。账户与交易规范继续细化：EIP-8141 说明存储退款只降低付款方费用、区块仍按退款前的执行 gas 计；EIP-8266 在 EIP-8250 的 nonce_keys/nonce_seq 下重新定义过期 nonce 模式；POST_TX 改名 ASSERT 已合并。

items.topic: frame 交易：退款、nonce 与付款
items.title: EIP-8141 PR：解释 gas 退款与区块上限
items.note: （soispoke）。存储退款降低付款方支付的金额，但区块在退款前就计入执行 gas，原文两段忽略了这个差别；PR 同时说明收据记录的是向付款方收取的 gas。
items.title_en: EIP-8141 PR: explain gas refunds and block limits
items.note_en: (soispoke). Storage refunds lower what the payer pays, but the block counts execution gas before those refunds, a difference two paragraphs of the spec overlooked. The PR also explains that receipts record the gas charged to the payer.

items.title: EIP-8266 PR：在 EIP-8250 下选择过期 nonce 模式
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）。EIP-8250 把 `nonce` 换成 `nonce_keys` 和 `nonce_seq`，并赋予 `MAX_NONCE_SEQ` 单次使用的含义，EIP-8266 原来的哨兵值写法需要对齐。
items.title_en: EIP-8266 PR: select expiring-nonce mode under EIP-8250
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil). EIP-8250 replaces `nonce` with `nonce_keys` and `nonce_seq` and gives `MAX_NONCE_SEQ` a single-use meaning, so EIP-8266's sentinel value needs to line up.

summary_en: Alex Stokes and Trent promoted the Hoodi upgrade: a 200M gas limit, larger contract size, ETH transfers emitting logs and gas repricing. Account and transaction specs kept getting refined. EIP-8141 explains that storage refunds only lower what the payer pays, while the block still counts execution gas before refunds; EIP-8266 redefines its expiring-nonce mode under EIP-8250's nonce_keys/nonce_seq; and the POST_TX to ASSERT rename was merged.
